question: How does population size affect territorial carbon dioxide emissions across countries from 1990 to 2020?
target_population: Countries and territories with comparable annual observations

constructs.name: population size
constructs.notes: Alternative specifications may use population growth or density.

constructs.name: territorial carbon dioxide emissions
constructs.notes: Must distinguish production-based from consumption-based emissions.

constructs.name: energy use
constructs.notes: Potential mechanism connecting population and emissions.

constructs.name: income per capita
constructs.notes: Development level may affect both demographic patterns and emissions.

constructs.name: industrial structure
constructs.notes: The population-emissions relationship may vary by sectoral composition.

constraints.other: Prefer versioned annual data with stable country identifiers.
